```lean
intro h
split
· intro s a ha
  rw [insert_eq_iff]
  rcases eq_or_mem (f s) (f (insert a s)) with (h1 | h2)
  · exact False.elim (h _ _ ha h1)
  · exact h _ _ ha h2
· intro h'
  intros s t hst
  by_cases h1 : s = t
  · exact hst
  · obtain ⟨a, h2, h3⟩ := set_diff_eq.mono hst
    have := h' s a h2
    exact this.trans h3
```
